reason: I already pay Instagram agents a deposit and wait weeks, and they never tell me all the fees up front, so a written quote, Zain Cash and paying shipping on arrival makes me willing to try once. I'd only do it for a bigger order of a few things together, not one cheap item.
objection: 13,000 a kilo plus 5,000 delivery plus the minimum fee means a cheap lipstick or phone case ends up costing double. Fees of 21,000 on a 30,000 item is a lot for someone on my salary, and I don't know this page yet.
would_change_my_mind: If they let me combine many small items from different shops into one package and only charged the delivery once, or charged by the real weight under one kilo.
